digest_review.reason: Known registry indexes already provide accepted child digests. When only the Kubernetes target can fetch the image, proof trusts the exact admitted Pod and kubelet pull of the immutable reference; it does not independently reconstruct index ancestry. Comparing an unknown index directly with the platform imageID would reject valid pulls.
